title: Prepregnancy exposure to dietary arsenic and congenital heart defects.
authors: Suhl J, Conway KM, Rhoads A, Langlois PH, Feldkamp ML, Michalski AM, Oleson J, Sidhu A, Scholz TD, Kancherla V, Obrycki J, Mazumdar M, Romitti PA, National Birth Defects Prevention Study.
quote: Compared with the low tertile of total arsenic exposure, positive associations (OR ≥ 1.2) were observed in both middle and high tertiles for perimembranous ventricular septal defect (VSD) and in the high tertile only for double outlet right ventricle‐transposition of the great arteries (DORV‐TGA), partial anomalous pulmonary venous return (PAPVR), and tricuspid atresia (Table 2).
